scenes.title: Verbs
scenes.purpose: Name the three actions with energy; each word performs itself.
scenes.visual: Three full-frame word cards on a 0.9 s beat: Fold squeezes in from a wide stretch, Crease tightens its tracking, Fly. smears in; its full stop (paper colour on terracotta) blooms into the page.

layout.landscape: Centred words fitted to the safe width

transition_out.continuity: The full stop of 'Fly.' grows into the paper page of the next scene.

scenes.title: Four folds
scenes.purpose: Show the four folds on one sheet with orientation (tracker) and two margin notes.
on_screen_text: Fold the sheet in half, lengthwise.
Fold the top corners to the crease.
Fold the new edges to the centre.
scenes.visual: One paper sheet morphs through four outlines (sheet, house, narrow point, dart); fold lines are drawn by a pen; a four-step tracker fills; hand-drawn notes point at the crease and the nose; corner labels count the folds.

layout.landscape: Copy and tracker left, sheet right
layout.portrait: Sheet above, copy and tracker below

transition_out.continuity: The finished plane launches; its flight is drawn on the same page.

scenes.title: Flight
scenes.purpose: Pay off the folds: the plane glides.
scenes.visual: The plane shrinks into a dot that draws a gliding path across the page; a note marks the landing.

transition_out.continuity: The landing dot blooms into the terracotta end card.

scenes.title: End
scenes.purpose: Close and hold with the call to action.
on_screen_text: Grab a sheet and fold one.
scenes.visual: End card in paper colour on terracotta; the frame labels stay.
